title: Agent Cognition Skills (ACS)
description:
Agent Cognition Skills (ACS)

A general-purpose AI cognition skill set for understanding human intent, improving a target, preserving decisions across sessions, learning from accumulated work, and stopping when independent evaluation finds nothing material left to change.

The operational skills are Intent, Goal, Improve, Record and Learn. Probe is optional research instrumentation. Improve is the normal entry point: Intent interprets the prompt, Improve selects and verifies the highest-leverage change, and Record preserves the evidence.

ACS implements the Principles of Earned Autonomy and works with Agent Context Memory (ACM). It gives no structural guarantee of faithful model reasoning; it keeps claims bounded, makes them observable, and requires independent evidence and evaluation where stronger conclusions are needed.

The public trail records repeated self-application and releases. Current behavior, installation, limitations and reproducible pilot evidence are documented in the repository README.
